To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the interaction between the machine and the grinding process has a major impact on grinding forces, grinding power, and grinding temperature, which can be predicted by the simulation concept developed in this paper.

the grinding wheel is not the only element of the machine that is displaced during grinding, but that all elements of the machine system, including the grinding wheel, are displaced during grinding, and that the displacement of the wheel is only the first step in a chain of events.

the interaction of the process and the machine during high performance grinding is a complex and nonlinear phenomenon that can be described with a modular simulation concept that allows for the consideration of different process and machine models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction between process and machine during grinding.
a simulation concept which allows the simulation of the grinding wheel, the grinding process and machine dynamics in one model.
the development of a simulation concept that allows a comprehensive simulation of high-performance grinding processes and machines.

the interaction between the machine and the grinding process is of high importance for the prediction of grinding performance.
the interaction of the grinding process with the grinding machine is a complex phenomenon that is not yet fully understood.
the grinding process and machine are coupled.

we have developed a simulation model that allows the prediction of grinding forces and grinding wheel wear for the first time.
the simulation of the grinding machine is a promising approach to improve the understanding of the interaction between the grinding process and machine.
the interaction of the grinding process with the machine system can be simulated with a sufficient accuracy.
